body.summary: In Night City, street kid David Martinez loses his mother to a gang crossfire and a Trauma Team that only saves paying clients, then has the military Sandevistan implant she was smuggling grafted onto his spine. He joins Maine's crew of edgerunners, rises as their leader after Maine burns out from cyberpsychosis, and takes a Militech fixer's job that turns out to be an Arasaka trap built around the cyberskeleton prototype. ||He dies fighting Adam Smasher in the prototype while Lucy escapes to the Moon, and the crew's survivors split his payout.||

arcs.summary: David loses his mother, takes the Sandevistan, and is drawn into the crew through a botched car heist with Lucy.
David earns his place in Maine's crew, learns to shoot, and grows close to Lucy.
The Tanaka data job goes wrong, Maine's cyberpsychosis worsens, and he and Dorio die fighting MaxTac.
David leads the crew, takes Faraday's Militech job, and the convoy turns out to be an Arasaka cyberskeleton trap.
David dons the cyberskeleton to save Lucy, fights Adam Smasher, and dies; Lucy reaches the Moon.

motifs: the Sandevistan and its count of uses per day
the moon and the moon braindance
Arasaka Tower as the unreachable top
themes: cyberware as both power and slow death
class and corpo hierarchy in Night City
the body as a disposable vessel

notable_scenes.summary: Gloria is caught in a gang crossfire; Trauma Team saves only the policyholder and leaves her to die.
David beats Katsuo with the Sandevistan at the Academy.
Lucy shows David the moon braindance in her apartment.
Maine, deep in cyberpsychosis, dies fighting MaxTac after Dorio is killed.
David installs the cyberskeleton in the truck and mows down Militech forces.
David fights Adam Smasher and dies; Lucy reaches the lunar surface.
